Q1.S009: engineered waveform features + MLP/RF + claimed ensemble; printed feature contract is inconsistent
Q1.independent_reference: normalized shape/time/slope/harmonic features + RF/SVM with grouped stress tests
Q1.selection_lesson: Use S010 interpretable kurtosis/FFT descriptors as a simple baseline, but freeze one schema and stress-test by held-out material/frequency/Bm regimes.
Q1.S010: 19 statistical/FFT/shape features + DT/RF/logistic + six-model vote; nearly perfect row-level metrics but incomplete printed final pipeline
Q1.S011: 13 time/frequency/PCA features → nonparametric screening → peak-factor+kurtosis → SVM/DT/stacking; 100% metrics but nested-screening/grouped validation not evidenced
Q1.S012: shape-threshold baseline → 5D statistics SVM → noise stress → Hilbert-Huang/bispectrum multi-domain SVM; printed feature scaling leaks validation extrema before split

Q2.S009: Steinmetz + three temperature corrections; selects Solow mainly by in-sample MAPE/stability
Q2.independent_reference: log-linear temperature correction with leave-one-temperature-out selection
Q2.selection_lesson: Combine S010 explicit hypothesis ladder with leave-temperature-out/leave-region-out selection and one parameter registry.
Q2.S010: six explicit temperature corrections with shuffled 5-fold KFold; better evaluation than pure in-sample fitting but not leave-temperature-out
Q2.S011: five temperature corrections + LS/SA/PSO/dynamic PSO; strong fit but model selection is on the same temperature support without leave-condition-out evidence
Q2.S012: SE → log-linear LSE → TLSE temperature correction → TLSEDSR adaptive coefficient network; strongest hypothesis ladder in group but validated by same-support random row split

Q3.S009: one/two/three-way ANOVA on raw core loss + group-average enumeration
Q3.independent_reference: log P ANCOVA/robust model with log f/log Bm + factors + requested two-way interactions
Q3.selection_lesson: Keep S010 effect-size reporting and frequency-stratified diagnosis, but estimate adjusted effects with log f/log Bm covariates before optimization.
Q3.S010: log-loss ANOVA/Welch + effect sizes + pairwise interactions; recognizes frequency-dependent 70C/90C reversal but does not fully control f/Bm
Q3.S011: Kruskal-Wallis + raw cross-tab mean/variance “synergy”; descriptive interaction claim remains confounded by f/Bm
Q3.S012: explicit three-factor ANOVA with interactions + one-way F ranking + sequential Mann-Whitney condition tournament; true interaction model is a strength, but F is misused as effect size and 47 tests are uncorrected/order-dependent

Q4.independent_reference: physics baseline + linear/tree/boosting competitors with grouped and leave-condition-out validation
Q4.selection_lesson: Use physics-derived IGSE as a baseline/residual feature only after an identical group-aware validation protocol and an executable final feature-transform contract.
Q4.S010: nine ML regressors + kurtosis ablation + claimed IGSE prior stacking; CatBoost best, but printed code only shows simpler five-feature CatBoost
Q4.S011: claimed feature-weight Bi-LSTM with 8:1:1 split; printed “Bi-LSTM” code is CNN-only and 1033-vs-10 feature contract disagrees
Q4.S012: DM/DMSDR/TDM → LMSE/LMSESDR → TLMSESDR → MTLMSESDR → WMTLMSEDSR; printed embeddings/code path are stronger implementation evidence, but validation remains random-row rather than leave-condition-out

Q5.S009: P/Q scalarization, claimed mixed-integer PSO; printed code is bounded 3-variable local minimize
Q5.independent_reference: enumeration/LHS Pareto baseline + NSGA-II or epsilon-constraint with explicit two-objective vector
Q5.selection_lesson: Do not inherit Q3 categories as fixed decisions before Pareto search; normalize objectives or retain Pareto front, unit-test categorical encoding, run repeated stochastic trials and replay feasibility.
Q5.S010: weighted sum + GA/PSO/GWO + 48 category sweep; printed code has unnormalized raw objective, missing GWO, category encoder type bug and hard-coded category settings
Q5.S011: weighted scalarization + claimed GA/PSO + NSGA-II/MOPSO; Pareto idea is stronger, but weight is endogenous, no Q5 code is printed and sample MOPSO points violate bounds
Q5.S012: weighted subtraction/ratio + printed GA/PSO on six variables; paper/code frequency bound drift (50000 vs 5000), continuous relaxation of discrete variables, and lambda=10/100 result-table replay mismatch invalidate reported optimum evidence

current_recommendation: Across S009-S012, build Q1 with an interpretable waveform baseline plus multi-domain features only after split/group-first preprocessing; build Q2 as a physics Steinmetz/log-linear baseline plus temperature correction and, only if leave-condition-out folds justify it, adaptive coefficient learning; build Q3 with one covariate-adjusted factorial model, explicit interactions, effect sizes/intervals and multiplicity-corrected post-hoc contrasts; build Q4 as a physics/empirical baseline plus a fixed-schema ablation ladder tested on leave-material/temperature/waveform/frequency-region folds; build Q5 from one machine-readable mixed-variable domain registry, retain a true Pareto/epsilon-constraint structure or normalized scalarization, and replay every reported point. S012 contributes the strongest printed implementation evidence for the adaptive empirical model, but its optimizer bounds/discreteness and lambda table cannot be trusted without correction.
new_gates_from_S011: Pareto quality metrics beyond visual concentration
new_gates_from_S012: ANOVA F statistic is not effect size
